text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're holding another concert to draw
support
for our project.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So our mini concert today will be
something new
for all of us, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Small or big, we give every concert
110%! Isn't
that right, Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Calculating probability of achieving
today's
objective: "convey gratitude"...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, no calculating!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whether or not we achieved our goal is
for the
audience to decide, not us!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We can ask them directly afterwards! I
bet they'll
all answer with a smile on
their face.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Post-concert protocol
updated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The mini concert ends in success.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How'd you like today's concert? Have
we made
you into an even bigger fan?!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, um, y-yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Falcon, enthusiasm overload. She's
shying away.

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... No, but I really did become a
fan.

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
I got to see a different side to you than
at the
races, and the emotions you gave
off felt...
different, somehow.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My... emotions?

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and now that I've gotten a glimpse
of them, I
want to feel them in full.

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind to cheer for you
not just in
your races, but in your
concerts too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! Why don't you try talking
directly
with a fan sometime?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Who knows, you might learn a thing or
two,
including what concerts mean to
you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Will I really learn anything?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, Suzuka was so peak today... I
mean, she
always is. Wonder if she'll be
in the next concert
too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me, may I have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa, Suzuka?! A-am I dreaming? Is
it really
you?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry to startle you. I just wanted to
ask you
something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Why does it make you happy? Me being
in a
concert, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Because I get to see you, that's
why!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But you get to see me when I race too,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's true,
but it's like... In races,
all I can
do is cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
So I like being able to sing along with
you, being
in the same space, sharing
the same feelings.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Concerts are where I can... welcome you
home, in
a way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Welcome... home?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You caught me off guard. Didn't think
you'd be
back yet.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's an interesting talk you had
with a fan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but... it strikes me as odd that a
concert
would be a place to say
"welcome home."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've said that exact thing before,
actually.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
See, when I'm racing you, what I see is a
back that
I need to catch up to.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But off the track—when I'm just
cheering—all I can
do is watch over you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I remember seeing you off before a
race—I was a
nervous wreck. All I could
think was, "Be back
soon."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And, "Please, please, come home to me
safely."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So when the race ended, and the stage
lit up, I
was so happy that I started
waving my hands
frantically...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The only words that came to mind were
"Welcome
home!" and "You did great!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And also, "Let's have tons of fun today!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I guess "welcome home" makes
me sound
like I'm your mom or
something.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When the concert starts, it's like we've
come
home together to the same place.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Come... home?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Sorry if none of this makes any
sense!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, that was helpful, thank you. I think
I'm
starting to understand.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Now I want to know how it feels to be
welcomed
home.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Suzuka, perfect timing. Mind if I ask
your
opinion on something?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove? Sure, I don't mind...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The student council is holding an
exhibition race, and one of the runners
had to drop out. So, if
possible, I was
thinking you could...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that there'll be a concert
involved as
well, and you'll need to learn
new choreography.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I doubt you'd object to another race,
but the concert would be a pain, so I'm
prepared to hear no for an answer. But
on the off chance that
you're willing...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fine to me. I'll learn the new

choreography.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You will?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Okay then, I'll register you right away.
Wait right
here!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Okay.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I can already hear the voices
welcoming me
home.
